name: ButterComp2
purpose: Smooth, glue-style compressor with a soft, musical, almost un-compressor-like feel: it thickens and evens out vocals, bass, guitars and buses without pumping or obvious grabbing. One Compress knob, plus output and dry/wet for parallel use.
avoid_for: very fast peak control (use a limiter or Multi-Comp FET)

expose.ai_hint: Amount of compression. 0.1-0.3 gentle glue, 0.4-0.6 clearly thicker and more even, 0.7+ heavy. Raises the level into the compressor by up to 14 dB, so the sound also gets louder.
Output level. 0.5 is unity (no change), 1.0 is +6 dB, 0 is silent. Trim down after a high Compress setting so level stays matched.
Dry/wet blend. 1.0 is fully compressed; 0.4-0.6 gives parallel compression that keeps transients and adds body.

notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Compress 0 is effectively off.
Pairs well after a faster compressor: use ButterComp2 as the gentle second stage for glue.
CPU: 0.59% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
